findings.title: Expected-input file is caller-defined, not a fixed QA allowlist
findings.repro: The actual bundled CLI test successfully exports Original0.txt/Original1.txt and arbitrary typed text after writing their tuples into --expected-inputs. None matches the three approved QA originals. CLI validates only shape/count, so replacing that file expands selection to any matching local batch.
findings.impact: Tool cannot guarantee MATCHED_LOCAL_QA_JOBS_ONLY or fixed synthetic dataset scope; unrelated batch identities/filenames/pins can be exported. It remains read-only and does not export raw content.
findings.fix: Pin the CLI to the approved three kind/filename/byteCount/hash tuples or bind the exact expected-file content hash. Keep general owning repository function reusable; reject altered/additional tuples before opening DB.

findings.title: Idle connection prevents finite server shutdown
findings.repro: Start --seconds1, open loopback socket without sending request bytes, wait2s: process remains alive. Closing idle client then lets it exit. Independent actual loopback receipt retained.
findings.impact: Single-threaded HTTPServer blocks in request parsing; Timer.shutdown cannot enforce <=900s lifetime and handler may continue after deadline. Only fixed synthetic files are exposed, but finite cleanup guarantee is false.
findings.fix: Enforce wall-clock shutdown independently of client activity, close active sockets at deadline or use bounded threaded handlers with a hard deadline; reject response after expiry and test idle/partial request sockets.

confirmed: SQLite readOnly/query_only and throwing runAsync/newId prevent product writes; owning list/reopen/recovery methods do not dispatch or schedule.
Repository Account/Trip and retained bytes/hash correlation tested; explicit CLI account argument is a local operator read pin, not Auth proof.
No raw text/bytes/session/token in exported pins; missing Source binding stays null NOT_SOURCE_PROOF.
Optional loopback server binds127.0.0.1 and only serves exact hash-checked synthetic file bytes; no upload/listing.
